title: Quest Room Branches
dek: Rescue aftermath, investigations, negotiations and split-party encounters woven into the existing adventure histories.
body:
Quest parties often split into separate rooms for simultaneous scenes. These exchanges extend the existing adventure record: a side room is not automatically another quest, and an accessible transcript does not make every discovery public knowledge.

Read the scenes alongside their parent adventure record. Dates here are Discord posting periods, not an in-world calendar. Some rooms continued after their creation, so a room’s opening date is not used to date every later exchange.

March 2024 · the rescue aftermath

Rescue followed by repair — After Farmer Frank’s family is rescued, Vigr and Cobble refuse repayment and offer to help restore his home.

Tools for the fields — Gartina commissions six each of hoes, spades and pitchforks, plus three plow blades, from Jon.

August 2024 · investigation and a Rahu visit

Grief and the limits of vengeance — During the Swift Foot investigation, Dorian threatens three Rahu witnesses who repeat the account given by their captain.

Craftsmanship at the Rahu visit — Alyhotep asks Shogun Yoshida how Pristinia could learn from Rahu building methods.

The search reaches Roger’s house — In the Pristinia Haze investigation, Caravash searches Roger’s inherited house and hears labored breathing behind a basement door.

December 2024 · an embassy evening and a mansion visit

A quiet moment at the embassy — At the Longest Night gathering, Cecil and Strange Talon discuss thought, action and the fleeting reflection of stars in the koi pond.

The mansion misunderstanding ends — The McKalister mansion branch ends with Kevin explaining that he was protecting the family’s collectible haul.

January 2025 · festival negotiations

Sewer aid and a coastal outpost — After the Kinnich Ahau festival, Hildethrax clarifies that Rahu materials are intended for Eovar’s sewer repairs; what the Rahu want in exchange is land for a coastal outpost.

Assistance without surrendering conscience — Lionel introduces himself to Sophina after helping track Ithilrune.

The Flying Jib’s stake in diplomacy — Maartje Twellaar explains to Kitty that knowing Eovar’s political decisions protects the Flying Jib: unknowingly admitting a banned guest could threaten her business.

An investment conversation — Fenwick asks Paetr the Counter about future investment in Eovar.

March–July 2025 · danger at sea and refugee aid

The shark diversion breaks down — During the Sahuagin encounter, Carmen’s shark form charges ahead and nearly catches Sparrow.

Aid before trade — During the pirate hostage crisis, Fenwick, Brianna and Ithilrune visit a rebuilding coastal refugee settlement on Gael.

August 2025 · meeting the Zarathians

A recommendation after the battle — Captain Zythienne praises Draygar’s initial charge in the dragon-isle battle and offers to recommend him to Captain Tarwen of the Silver Star.

Exploration as a vocation — Zeke, a Radiant Dawn sailor, takes Wren and Elenia to the fleet and describes mapping new islands before scholars come to study them.

Stone, water and a difficult reconciliation — Fenwae, a Silver Star stone mason, shows Olokun a marble quarry and an unfinished dam intended to collect drinking water.

September 2025 · pursuit and harbor clues

Preparing to intercept Magnus — Eugene orders his crew to meet Magnus’s ship head-on and lets the archers fire when confident of a hit.

A body beneath Eovar’s docks — Investigating disappearances near Eovar, Rogof Stonecutter notices strangely circling water, uses Mage Hand to probe the surface, and brings a man’s body ashore.

January–February 2026 · woodland and embassy branches

The direct route to the Lunar Tear — Boggun and Ryvyt push straight through thick woodland during the Lunar Tear expedition.

A contest resumes after the disturbance — At the Kinnich Ahau embassy feast, Ibere and Ahuic fight unarmed while Zorkris watches.

The observance continues — During the same feast, Serath approaches the priests chanting around a central brazier and tries to understand the ceremony.

Coverage and boundaries

The supplied archive contains 50 accessible rooms and 4,949 messages. Forty-nine room associations are anchored by matching thread identifiers and parent-channel creation messages; the Aiko cottage association is contextual. Association labels help locate scenes and are not official quest titles. The archive does not include inaccessible unjoined private rooms, deleted messages or attachment contents.

The Pristinia Library exchange is already included in the later quest continuation and is not counted as another event. Private exchanges, protected lore and unresolved puzzle answers remain outside the public files. An omitted room does not imply that nothing happened there.
